_comment: AUTHORITATIVE, MACHINE-READABLE IDP template schema. This is GROUND TRUTH. The extractor loads this; the AI treats it as non-negotiable. If the template changes, re-dump the header rows and update this file + HANDOFF_IDP_Extractor_BuildGuide.md. Do NOT reconstruct these facts from memory.
downstream_consumer: LISA (reads by header text; Wire Labels are TEXTJOIN-computed inside the workbook)

ConduitIndex.name_split_rule: Name 1 = equipment TAG, Name 2 = DESCRIPTION, Name 3 = extra line

columns.meaning: Source TAG. NOTE double space + trailing space in header.
Comma-sep INDEX NUMBERS into 'Ref Documents & Deviations' sheet.
Deviation-note NUMBER(S) (col E of Ref sheet).

FillIndex.row_semantics: One row per WIRE GROUP / CONNECTION SET within a conduit (connection-level, NOT raw cable conductor count).

columns.meaning: Must match a ConduitIndex Conduit Name. Required.
CONNECTION count, not raw conductor count.
On-drawing FILL TYPE. NOT the PickList FillType (THHN/Cat5e).
Source symbol block name from symbol_cascade.
Source device tags. 'S Tag 1 ' has trailing space.
COMPUTED by TEXTJOIN in-workbook. Do NOT populate unless mode=Custom.
Number the ConduitIndex 'Ref Documents' cell references.
Number the ConduitIndex 'Deviations Notes' cell references.

rules.wire_ct_is_connection_count: Wire Ct = number of connections in the group, NOT raw conductors. A 37-conductor cable landed as one MFG_CABLE = Wire Ct 1.
rules.wire_label_grammar: SrcName:SrcTag:SrcTerm / DstName:DstTag:DstTerm. Empty segments collapse; drop name when it equals the tag. SrcName=ConduitIndex col B, DstName=col E.
rules.tag_suppression: Per row, show a tag only when it differs from the previous shown tag; blank consecutive repeats. Terms are NEVER suppressed.
rules.conduit_type_normalize: PVC-40->PVC, GRC/RIGID->RGS. Flag anything that doesn't map.
rules.defaults_must_be_flagged: Every applied default (Type/Gauge/Color) must be surfaced and the cell flagged amber; never silently apply.
rules.no_overwrite: Never overwrite a prior filled workbook. Write _vN versions so previous extraction results are preserved.
rules.template_is_read_only: Never write to the template. Copy it, then fill the copy.
rules.lisa_symbol_contract: S/D Symbol MUST be a member of named range KEY(Type)_<WireCt>_<L|R>, KEY(Type)=Type.replace('-',''). Type MUST be in Type_<WireCt>. Enforced by lisa_contract.py against Handoff/lisa_symbols.json. A symbol outside its dropdown = LISA cannot map it = no drawing.
rules.lisa_slot_count: Each symbol activates exactly BlockTags[symbol] Tag/Term slots; the workbook greys the rest. Do not fill more Tag/Term columns than the slot count.
rules.lisa_generation: LISA generates one DWG per conduit + one .wdp project file. It can consume a conduit-list .txt (names, one per line/comma-separated) to generate a subset.

lisa_contract_file: Handoff/lisa_symbols.json (regenerate with export_lisa_contract.py when the block library changes)
